scenes.title: Finn Wakes Up in the Forest
scenes.description: Finn the Fox stretches under the giant oak tree as morning light filters through the leaves. Birds are singing, but Finn feels a heavy quiet inside.

choices.label: Go toward the sunny meadow
choices.detailText: Finn decides to step into the warm sunshine.

choices.label: Go toward the rainy path
choices.detailText: Finn drifts toward the shadowy mist under grey clouds.

scenes.title: The Meadow & The Old Bridge
scenes.description: In the meadow, bright golden wildflowers bloom. Finn hears laughter by the stream where squirrels are playing tag.

choices.label: Ask to join the game
choices.detailText: Finn runs over to join in the friendly game.

choices.label: Watch quietly from far away
choices.detailText: Finn sits under a bush, feeling left out.

scenes.title: The Rainy Path & The Falling Leaves
scenes.description: Soft rain patters on Finn's ears. Finn feels sluggish and wonders if anyone noticed he wandered off alone.

choices.label: Look for a warm hollow log
choices.detailText: Finn tries to find cover from the rain.

choices.label: Keep walking slowly in rain
choices.detailText: Finn keeps wandering without picking a place to rest.

scenes.title: Friends Play Ball by the Meadow
scenes.description: Two friendly animals kick a ball back and forth and look over at Finn. One of them rolls the ball toward Finn, waving for him to come play.

choices.label: Join the game
choices.detailText: Finn steps forward and kicks the ball back to join the fun.

choices.label: Stay back
choices.detailText: Finn steps back behind a tree, feeling hesitant.

scenes.title: Playing Ball Together
scenes.description: Finn passes the ball and everyone cheers! Finn feels warm inside after taking a brave step.

choices.label: Head toward the wooden bridge
choices.detailText: Finn trots happily toward the river bridge.

scenes.title: Watching from the Shadows
scenes.description: Finn watches the game from behind a tree, wishing he had joined but feeling too nervous to try.

choices.label: Walk quietly toward the bridge
choices.detailText: Finn quietly slips past toward the river bridge.

scenes.title: Crossing the Wobbly Bridge
scenes.description: Finn arrives at a wooden rope bridge stretching over a wide rushing river. The bridge sways gently in the breeze.

choices.label: Take one step at a time
choices.detailText: Finn takes a deep breath and steps forward carefully.

choices.label: Dash across without looking!
choices.detailText: Finn runs fast without taking a moment to look.

choices.label: Stop and hide behind a boulder
choices.detailText: Finn feels worried that the bridge might break.

scenes.title: The Tangled Berry Patch
scenes.description: On the other side of the bridge, tasty blackberries grow! But prickly thorns block the path and snag Finn's fur.

choices.label: Kick the thorny bushes in anger
choices.detailText: Finn gets mad and growls at the brambles.

choices.label: Ask a badger friend for help
choices.detailText: Finn asks nicely for a friend's help.

choices.label: Look for a path around the side
choices.detailText: Finn stays calm and searches for a clear way.

scenes.title: The Forest Guard's Sign
scenes.description: Finn finds a wooden sign placed by Owl the Forest Warden reading: 'DO NOT ENTER - SLEEPING BEAR AHEAD'.

choices.label: Follow the sign & take safe path
choices.detailText: Finn respects the forest rule and turns right.

choices.label: Sneak past the sign anyway!
choices.detailText: Finn decides to push past the rule just to see.

scenes.title: The Crystal Pond Reflection
scenes.description: Finn sits beside a crystal clear pond. Gazing into the water, Finn sees his reflection surrounded by shimmering water lilies.

choices.label: Smile and say 'I did a great job today!'
choices.detailText: Finn feels proud of himself.

choices.label: Frown and think 'I am not good at this'
choices.detailText: Finn feels self-critical and doubts his strength.

scenes.title: The Starry Clearing & Glowing Stones
scenes.description: Finn arrives at the heart of the forest where ancient glowing stones form a magical puzzle path. A wise old Turtle asks Finn to wait until all 3 stones light up.

choices.label: Wait patiently for the 3rd stone
choices.detailText: Finn counts to three and waits for the signal.

choices.label: Leap onto the stones immediately!
choices.detailText: Finn gets excited and jumps without waiting.

scenes.title: Cozy Evening at the Fox Cozy Den
scenes.description: The golden sun sets over the forest as Finn returns safely home to the warm cozy den. Finn curls up happily after a wonderful day of adventure.
